svg.title: Request idempotency: retries for an already-saved document
svg.desc: A browser repeats the POST with the same UUID key and request inputs. Our code in the Django API computes a fingerprint. A PostgreSQL transaction locks the owner's stream and finds Job by owner and idempotency key. Our Python compares fingerprints: no existing Job creates Job and OutboxEvent together; matching fingerprint returns the same Job ID and current status; different fingerprint returns 409 without a new Job.
svg.text: Same UUID idempotency key + same request inputs
Our Python receives the existing Job (or none)
Our code compares the stored and request fingerprints
Our code creates Job + OutboxEvent together
CURRENT status, not a fresh execution
No new Job or outbox row
No new Job or outbox row
All three outcomes are our code inside this same Django request handler.
Logos identify technology. Blue: our code. Green: stored data / SQL. Purple: framework.
